app.name: PMToolkit
app.description: Essential calculators and tools for Product Managers

feedback.attentionDesc: Result below expectations. Consider improvement actions.

roi.name: ROI
roi.description: Calculate return on investment to evaluate the profitability of a project or campaign.

cac.name: CAC
cac.description: Calculate customer acquisition cost to optimize your marketing and sales investments.

ltv.name: LTV
ltv.description: Calculate customer lifetime value to understand how much revenue each customer generates over time.

mrr.name: MRR/ARR
mrr.description: Calculate monthly and annual recurring revenue for your SaaS business.

grossMargin.name: Gross Margin
grossMargin.description: Calculate gross margin to understand the basic profitability of your product or service.

activationRate.name: Activation Rate
activationRate.description: Measure the percentage of users who complete the key activation action after signup.

churnRate.name: Churn Rate
churnRate.description: Calculate churn and retention rate to monitor your business health.

dauMau.name: DAU/MAU
dauMau.description: Calculate the ratio of daily vs monthly active users to measure engagement.

kFactor.name: K-Factor
kFactor.description: Calculate your product's virality factor to understand organic growth.

nps.name: NPS
nps.description: Calculate NPS to measure customer loyalty and satisfaction.

csat.name: CSAT
csat.description: Calculate customer satisfaction score based on surveys.

ttv.name: TTV
ttv.description: Calculate the average time until the customer perceives value in the product.

taskSuccessRate.name: Task Success Rate
taskSuccessRate.description: Measure the percentage of tasks successfully completed by users.

featureAdoption.name: Feature Adoption
featureAdoption.description: Calculate the percentage of users who adopted a new feature.

leadTime.name: Lead Time
leadTime.description: Measure the average time from commit to production deployment.

deploymentFrequency.name: Deployment Frequency
deploymentFrequency.description: Calculate how many deploys are performed per time period.

changeFailureRate.name: Change Failure Rate
changeFailureRate.description: Calculate the percentage of deploys that result in failures or rollbacks.

mttr.name: MTTR
mttr.description: Calculate the average time to recovery after production incidents.

footer.aboutDesc: A collection of tools and calculators for Product Managers.
footer.creator: About the Creator
footer.creatorDesc: Product Manager passionate about data and tools that facilitate decision making.
footer.referencesDesc: Recommended books and materials to deepen your knowledge.
